title: Canonical scalar restriction and derived tensor unit and composition maps
statement: Let $\mathcal C,J$ and the coefficient universe satisfy the site, sheafification and size assumptions of [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model]. For maps $\varphi:R\to S$, $\psi:S\to T$ and $\gamma:R\to T$ of sheaves of commutative rings, with a specified equality $\gamma=\psi\circ\varphi$, define the scalar-restriction composition isomorphism $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\operatorname{Res}_\psi\cong\operatorname{Res}_\gamma$ by the identity maps on sections, regarded as linear maps through this equality. For $\varphi:R\to R$ with a specified equality $\varphi=1_R$, define $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\cong 1$ in the same way. Given normalized scalar models $A,B,F$ [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model] for $\varphi,\psi,\gamma$, define the derived tensor composition isomorphism $B.T\circ A.T\cong F.T$ to be the left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism between the composite derived adjunction, transported by the exact derived scalar-restriction composition isomorphism, and $F$'s derived adjunction. Given a normalized model $A$ for $\varphi=1_R$, define $A.T\cong1_{D(R)}$ by left-adjoint uniqueness between its derived adjunction transported by the exact derived restriction identity isomorphism and the identity adjunction. The exact derived restriction comparisons here are obtained by localization of the preceding sectionwise restriction isomorphisms, using the composition and identity comparisons of exact derived functors. These are definitions of specified maps, without asserting their representative formulas or choosing comparisons from an existence theorem.
